content: Rust ONNX inference serving stack: ort for ONNX Runtime, tonic 0.14 for gRPC, axum 0.8 for HTTP, hf-hub 1.0 for model downloads, tokenizers 0.23 for tokenization. Arc<Mutex<Session>> for thread-safe inference. Axum+tonic multiplexing via content-type routing. metrics crate for Prometheus, tracing+opentelemetry for distributed tracing. Production config: intra_threads=num_cpus, optimization_level=Level3, CPU EP.
